translations.literal: Tang regulations fixed the flowing ranks from the first to the ninth grade, with a system of primary, secondary, upper, and lower steps.

sentences.zh: 其後，升侍中、中書令為正二品，御史大夫、散騎常侍、兩省侍郎為正三品，御史中丞正四品。

translations.literal: Later, the Grand Counselor and Director of the Secretariat were raised to the second primary grade; the Censor-in-Chief, Palace Attendant Extraordinary, and vice directors of the two departments to the third primary grade; and the Vice Censor-in-Chief to the fourth primary grade.
translations.idiomatic: Later the grand counselor and director of the secretariat were raised to second primary grade; the censor-in-chief, palace attendant extraordinary, and vice directors of the two departments to third primary grade; and the vice censor-in-chief to fourth primary grade.

sentences.zh: 諫議大夫分左、右，改將作大匠為監，太史局為司天監，置大監正三品，少監正四品上，丞正六品上，寺簿正七品上，主事正八品下，五官正五品上，副正正六品，靈台郎正七品下，保章正從七品上，挈壺正八品上，五官監候正八品下，司曆從八品上，司辰正九品上。

translations.literal: Remonstrance Officials were divided into left and right; the Director of Palace Construction was changed to Supervisor; the Astronomical Bureau became the Directorate of Astronomy; a Grand Supervisor was placed at the third primary grade, a Vice Supervisor at upper fourth primary grade, a Director at upper sixth primary grade, a Registrar at upper seventh primary grade, a Chief Clerk at lower eighth primary grade, an Astronomical Officer at upper fifth primary grade, a Deputy Astronomical Officer at sixth primary grade, an Observatory Gentleman at lower seventh primary grade, a Calendar Keeper at upper seventh primary grade, a Clepsydra Keeper at upper eighth primary grade, an Astronomical Observer at lower eighth primary grade, a Calendar Officer at upper eighth secondary grade, and a Timekeeper at upper ninth primary grade.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance officials were split into left and right ranks; the director of palace construction became a supervisor; the astronomical bureau became the directorate of astronomy; and new grades were set for its grand supervisor, vice supervisor, director, registrar, chief clerk, astronomical officers, observatory gentlemen, calendar keepers, clepsydra keepers, observers, calendar officers, and timekeepers.

sentences.zh: 又置國子、五經博士為正五品上，左、右金吾衛上將軍為從二品，左、右龍武、神武軍大將軍為正三品，將軍為從三品。

translations.literal: Erudites of the Directorate and Five Classics were also placed at upper fifth primary grade; Senior Generals of the Left and Right Golden Guard were made second secondary grade; Grand Generals of the Left and Right Dragon Martial and Divine Martial Armies were made third primary grade; and their generals third secondary grade.
translations.idiomatic: Directorate and Five Classics erudites were set at upper fifth primary grade; senior generals of the left and right golden guard at second secondary grade; grand generals of the left and right dragon martial and divine martial armies at third primary grade; and their generals at third secondary grade.

sentences.zh: 又置內侍監為正三品，少監從四品，改諸州府學博士為文學，在參軍上。

translations.literal: The Director of Palace Attendants was also placed at the third primary grade and the Vice Director at the fourth secondary grade; prefectural and district academy erudites were changed to Literary Officers, ranking above adjutants.
translations.idiomatic: The director of palace attendants was placed at third primary grade and the vice director at fourth secondary grade; prefectural academy erudites were retitled literary officers and ranked above adjutants.

sentences.zh: 五代復置尚書令為一品，升右丞為正四品上，降諫議在給事之下。

translations.literal: In the Five Dynasties the Director of the Department of State Affairs was restored to the first grade; the right vice director was raised to upper fourth primary grade; and remonstrance officials were lowered below petitioners.
translations.idiomatic: In the Five Dynasties the director of the department of state affairs was restored to first grade; the right vice director was raised to upper fourth primary grade; and remonstrance officials were placed below petitioners.

sentences.zh: 宋初，並因其制，唯升宗正卿為正四品，丞為從五品。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Song they largely followed this system, only raising the Director of the Imperial Clan to the fourth primary grade and the vice director to the fifth secondary grade.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Song they largely kept this system, only raising the director of the imperial clan to fourth primary grade and the vice director to fifth secondary grade.
